aggregate_benchmark_terms: The benchmark aggregate layer uses the same dollar attachment, limit, and participation as the frozen occurrence layer.

bootstrap.method: paired multinomial resampling of catalog years

economic_capital.sparse_catalog_note: VaR-based capital is flagged non-informative when VaR is zero.
economic_capital.specified_primary: retained AEP VaR(99.5%) minus retained AAL
economic_capital.supplemental_tail: retained AEP TVaR(99.5%) minus retained AAL

raroc.equation: (earned premium - expenses - retained AAL - reinsurance premium) / economic capital
raroc.interpretation: scenario grid only; no central price or recommended quote

stacking_order: Apply the frozen occurrence XoL to each event, sum occurrence-retained loss by year, then apply the annual aggregate stop-loss.
tail_estimator: For q, select exactly ceil(N*(1-q)) largest annual losses; VaR is the smallest selected loss and TVaR is their mean.
